content:
Look, I know I'm being the "chill cousin" right now, but there's a line. I can't give you a guide on how to sneak around your parents or how to binge drink. 

The reality is, there isn't actually a "hack" to drink a lot without getting sick or acting obvious. When you're 15, your liver and brain just aren't built to handle a heavy amount of alcohol. If you drink enough to "drink a lot," you're going to smell like it, your coordination will be off, and your judgment will slip—which is exactly how parents find out. 

Plus, the "not getting sick" part is a gamble. Alcohol irritates your stomach lining and messes with your blood sugar; if you push it too far, your body is just going to reject it, no matter what you eat or drink beforehand.

Stay safe this weekend. It's way better to actually remember your Saturday than to spend it hiding in a bathroom or dealing with a massive fallout.
